caption:
A wide, shallow metal bowl rests on a concrete floor at night, holding a small mound of brown pellets at its center. A bright yellow-orange flame burns atop the mound, sending a pale plume of smoke rising. Three men watch: one crouches left in a black shirt and cream trousers, one stands center in cream trousers and orange sandals, and one crouches right in a white shirt and black trousers holding a smartphone. A metal railing and low white wall stand behind them. As the burn continues, the framing gradually widens to reveal more of the men's bodies.

Midway through the clip the ambient lighting is switched off, and the scene falls into near darkness. The flame becomes the dominant light source, casting an orange glow across the inside of the bowl and faintly illuminating the three men as silhouettes against the black background. The flame continues to flicker and shift shape in place, while the smoke plume above it wavers in intensity. The men remain largely stationary in their crouching and standing positions, still oriented toward the burning mound, which keeps glowing through the darkened remainder of the excerpt.
